# Barbarian (`classes:barbarian`)
**Hit Die:** d12 | **Saving Throws:** [STR](../ability-scores/str.md), [CON](../ability-scores/con.md)
**Primary Ability:** [STR](../ability-scores/str.md)
**Subclasses:** [Path of the Berserker](../subclasses/path-of-the-berserker.md)
**Proficiencies:** [Light Armor](../proficiencies/light-armor.md), [Medium Armor](../proficiencies/medium-armor.md), [Shields](../proficiencies/shields.md), [Simple Weapons](../proficiencies/simple-weapons.md), [Martial Weapons](../proficiencies/martial-weapons.md), [Saving Throw: STR](../proficiencies/saving-throw-str.md), [Saving Throw: CON](../proficiencies/saving-throw-con.md)

## Proficiency Choices
- Choose 2: Animal Handling, Athletics, Intimidation, Nature, Perception, or Survival ([Skill: Animal Handling](../proficiencies/skill-animal-handling.md), [Skill: Athletics](../proficiencies/skill-athletics.md), [Skill: Intimidation](../proficiencies/skill-intimidation.md), [Skill: Nature](../proficiencies/skill-nature.md), [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md), [Skill: Survival](../proficiencies/skill-survival.md))

## Starting Equipment
- (a) Greataxe, 4 Handaxes, Explorer's Pack, and 15 GP or (b) 75 GP ([Greataxe](../equipment/greataxe.md), [Handaxe](../equipment/handaxe.md), [Explorer's Pack](../equipment/explorers-pack.md))

## Multiclassing
- Prerequisites: [STR](../ability-scores/str.md) 13+
- Proficiencies: [Shields](../proficiencies/shields.md), [Martial Weapons](../proficiencies/martial-weapons.md)
